meta.title: Reject a bid without allowing the seller to bid again

steps.note: Open the prepared auction Responses tab containing the vendor bid.

args.goal: Open the three-dot menu next to the vendor's bid, select Reject Bid, leave the allow-to-bid-again checkbox unchecked, confirm the rejection, and stop when the bid is removed from the Responses comparison view

steps.note: Perform the rejection flow and leave re-bidding disabled as required by the case.
Verify the rejected bid is no longer shown in the buyer's Responses comparison view.
Open the prepared event's Master QCS after rejection.
Verify the rejected vendor bid is absent from the QCS.
Switch to the invited vendor's supplier portal to test re-bidding.
Open the rejected auction round in the vendor portal.
Attempt a new bid and require Procol to refuse it because re-bidding was disabled.
